from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single revenue figure extracted from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers (e.g., '2022', '2023')")
    revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="The revenue figure reported as a number")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of filing (e.g., '10-K', 'Annual Report')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the revenue figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_records: list[RevenueRecord]
